question_text: On the basis of chemical structure, fatty acids can be divided into:
explanation: Fatty acids can be classified based on their chemical structure. Saturated fatty acids have no double bonds between carbon atoms (only single bonds), whereas unsaturated fatty acids have one or more double bonds in the carbon chain. Therefore, they are divided into saturated and unsaturated fatty acids.
